title: Evidence Bundle Envelope
description: Wrapper that ties together the artefacts handed to the release layer as a unit: passing eval reports, trace IDs, diffs, policy outputs, security static analysis, integrity attestation, the agentic provenance record, and a reference to the control state record. A release layer that accepts a deployable without a complete evidence bundle is accepting unverified output. Implements the evidence bundle, security static analysis, bundle integrity attestation, and provenance reference described in manifesto-done.md. STATUS: DRAFT — governance-authority signoff required.

loop_iteration_id.description: Joins to the agentic provenance record and the control state record for the same iteration.

evaluation_reports.description: Passing evaluation reports with timestamps. At least one report is required; the gate is only passed when no required report is in 'failed' state.

trace_ids.description: Trace IDs linking specification to execution to output.

diffs.description: References (URLs, SHAs, paths) to diffs showing exactly what changed.

security_static_analysis.description: Required when loop output produces code touching external interfaces (HTTP endpoints, user-input processing, database queries, file system operations, external API calls). Must pass with no unresolved Critical or High findings; ASVS-calibrated. Specific tooling is an implementation choice.

waiver_approved_by.description: Accountable human who approved the waiver. Required when status='waived'.

integrity_attestation.description: Integrity protection over the assembled bundle. Verifiable at release-gate assessment; retained for the operational lifetime of the system. In regulated environments where tamper-evident audit trails are legally required, digital signatures with non-repudiation properties are the appropriate mechanism.

key_identifier.description: Required when mechanism='signature'; key controlled by release system or accountable human.

non_repudiation.description: True when digital signature with non-repudiation properties is used.

provenance_record_ref.description: Reference to the agentic-provenance-record.json instance for this loop iteration. Absence is treated as evidence-bundle incompleteness, not as a pass.

control_state_record_ref.description: Reference to the companion control-state-record.json instance.
